skills.name: create-nestjs-module
skills.description: Scaffold a new NestJS domain submodule in a tower (PM, INV, OMS, FUL). Creates folder structure, Drizzle schema, Zod DTOs, service, controller, module registration, and generates database migration.

skills.name: create-react-page
skills.description: Scaffold a new React page in client-portal or admin-portal. Creates the page component, adds the route to App.tsx. Hooks and business logic remain manual.

skills.name: database-migration
skills.description: Run Drizzle ORM schema diffing to generate migration SQL files, review the output, and apply migrations via pnpm db:migrate. Handles new tables, column modifications, indexes, and data migrations.
